name: Hy Memory
summary: Tencent Hunyuan's dual-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK for agents, with chat, working and coding memory pipelines plus the MemHub app.
description: PyPI `hy-memory` 2.0.5 (2026-10-22). MemHub is a local-first desktop and CLI (`memhub-cli`) that unifies history and coding traces from tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Qwen Code for cross-app recall. Tencent also open-sourced the Hy-Memory-30B-A3B memory-writing model on Hugging Face. The LICENSE file states Apache-2.0 (GitHub reports it as Other).
